categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet descriptor lock handling across src/wallet/
categories.rationale: Replaces DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan's public recursive mutex with an encapsulated non-recursive mutex as part of tracking issue #19303. This clarifies lock hierarchy, enables Clang thread-safety annotations, and mitigates potential re-entrancy deadlocks during synchronous callbacks, but is primarily internal concurrency maintenance without an active user-facing failure.
